2609.03742.title: KnowVis: Knowledge-Centric Visual Summarization for Video Lectures
2609.03742.paper_summary: Video lectures are valuable educational resources, but their dense and lengthy formats often overwhelm novice learners. This difficulty stems from a fundamental pedagogical mismatch: while videos deliver transient information linearly, human learning requires constructing interconnected cognitive networks, a task that induces severe cognitive overload for novice learners lacking prior domain knowledge. Existing video summarization methods fail to resolve this mismatch, as they primarily produce text-heavy, linear condensations that still demand high cognitive effort. To bridge this gap, we propose KnowVis, a framework that transforms linear video lectures into pedagogically grounded visual narratives. KnowVis first extracts a detailed concept map from multimodal video content to identify important and challenging threshold concepts, then constructs structured knowledge units, and finally synthesizes engaging visual summaries. Alongside the framework, we introduce a curated dataset of 125 educational videos across 10 academic disciplines, paired with 1,079 generated visual summaries. Extensive automated evaluations and a human study demonstrate that, compared to state-of-the-art baselines, KnowVis generates more accurate and clear visuals that successfully reduce cognitive load and significantly improve student learning effectiveness and knowledge retention.
2609.03742.paper_summary_zh: 視頻講座是寶貴的教育資源，但其密集且冗長的格式常常讓初學者感到不知所措。這種困難源於根本的教學不匹配：雖然視頻以線性方式傳遞瞬時信息，但人類學習需要構建相互聯繫的認知網絡，這對於缺乏先前領域知識的初學者來說是一項導致嚴重認知過載的任務。現有的視頻摘要方法無法解決這一不匹配，因為它們主要生成文字密集的線性濃縮，仍然需要高認知努力。為了填補這一空白，我們提出了KnowVis，一個將線性視頻講座轉化為以教學為基礎的視覺敘事的框架。KnowVis首先從多模態視頻內容中提取詳細的概念圖，以識別重要且具有挑戰性的門檻概念，然後構建結構化的知識單元，最後合成引人入勝的視覺摘要。除了這個框架，我們還介紹了一個涵蓋10個學術學科的125個教育視頻的策展數據集，並配有1,079個生成的視覺摘要。廣泛的自動評估和人類研究表明，與最先進的基準相比，KnowVis生成的視覺更準確、更清晰，成功減少了認知負擔，並顯著提高了學生的學習效果和知識保留。
